1.1.2.9-f1.accuracy_reason: Tradux means a vine-layer, and 'ex traduce' is the standard formula for traducianism.

1.1.2.9-f2.accuracy_reason: Goclenius published his collection Psychologia (Ψυχολογία, hoc est de hominis perfectione…) at Marburg in 1590.

1.1.2.9-f7.accuracy_reason: Burton's 'lib. 10 de rep.' is the myth of Er (Republic 614b–621d), where souls draw lots and choose their next lives.

1.1.2.9-f9.accuracy_reason: The lines are Lucretius, De rerum natura 3.445–446; Burton's 'lib. 1' is a misreference.
